contests.title: Indianapolis Public Education Corporation — School operating levy

provenance.sourceOrg: Indiana Department of Local Government Finance
provenance.quote:
Shall the Indianapolis Public Education Corporation increase property taxes paid
to the Indianapolis Public Schools (“IPS”) and participating charter schools for no
more than four (4) years for the purpose of funding teacher and staff retention,
professional development, and advancing academic programs and opportunities
by imposing a property tax rate that does not exceed $0.372 per $100 of assessed
value and results in a maximum annual amount that does not exceed $95,000,000?
If this operating referendum public question is approved by the voters, for a
median residence of $150,000, the property's annual property tax bill would
increase by $221 per year.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes a property-tax levy for Indianapolis Public Schools and participating charter schools for no more than four years, funding teacher and staff retention, professional development and academic programs. The rate is capped at $0.372 per $100 of assessed value and the annual levy at $95,000,000. The official illustration estimates a $221 annual increase for a $150,000 median residence.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the proposed school levy and its stated caps.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not approve this proposed levy through this question.
